transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time for this pre-purchase review. As you know, we're considering the vendor's indoor-air-quality monitoring system for the science wing. The preliminary discussion has focused on the six-monitor package at $3,100, though the nine-monitor package at $4,320 is also available. Before I give final approval, we need to complete our routine review: facilities check, funding review, and health review. Let's hear from each of you on your respective areas.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share the results of my facilities inspection. I completed the inspection this week, and I found that the science wing has nine separate classrooms, each with its own independent ventilation zone. That means each classroom needs its own monitor. The room-by-room report hasn't been entered into the purchasing worksheet yet, but the bottom line is: the six-monitor package won't adequately cover the science wing. We need the nine-monitor package.
